scope: current 85 public pages and each page research/topics/<ID>/manuscript.md plus validation.md
promotion_gate: FAIL: editorial score must be >=90 and boundary preservation must be 100 before page promotion

method.score_formula: 100 minus documented deductions for cross-page template duplication, thin manuscript, generic headings, missing research-package editorial record, missing 0/1/0 evidence, insufficient source rows/runs, missing chain terms, or absent executable command; no score is inferred from page count, static build, or author status
method.boundary_rule: 100 only when fixture status, NOT_RUN, live, practitioner, and production boundaries are all named and no unnegated overclaim is found; otherwise 0 fail-closed
method.known_limit: This is an editorial evidence audit, not practitioner review, live-model validation, or publication approval.
